title: Is there an RPG Maker MZ plugin to show the character face image above the text box (or an in-game way)

posts.author: Jacarim
posts.body:
Pretty simple, I'm just looking for a plugin, or an in-game way, that enables an option to place the 'face' image above the textbox, like in the image below:
I know I can kinda do that by just using the show image function, but I would prefer an option to edit that on the message function itself instead

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
Hi there!
My plugin can do the trick:
Hakuen Studio Face Window for RPG Maker MZ by Hakuen Studio
Show the face image of the message box in a different window!
hakuenstudio.itch.io
It's called Face Window because it was inspired by Shining Force 1 game, from Sega Genesis. But you just need to set the window background transparent, then the face can be shown like your screenshot.

I tried an MZ replacement for Yanfly's Message Core which seemed to do that by default. I think it was GabeMZ_MessagePlus. Like Yanfly's, it includes codes to show the face of a party member by index or an actor by ID number.
EDIT
: I can't remember whether it did that to the text box or the face.
Either way, it wasn't a bad plugin but I needed something to work with the conditional hide choices plugin I was using.
